svg.title: Ask Kowhai Microsoft service architecture
svg.desc: SPFx floating chat on SharePoint uses Graph for group membership and MSAL with Entra for sign-in, then calls Copilot Studio. Power Platform contains the agent and Dataverse. Development and billing are separate management flows. Future SharePoint knowledge and alternative channels are marked separately. Live integration and billing remain unverified.
svg.text: AiSkills tenant / FrontLine SharePoint / Implemented proof of concept and related services
Web App iframe: prior access failure
FrontLine site and installed SPFx extension
Group check → floating icon → chat panel
Copilot Studio SDK + Bot Framework WebChat
Tokens: browser session storage · No client secret
Live sign-in and an agent reply need validation.
Build and tests → package .sppkg → SharePoint App Catalog
Install or update on FrontLine; approve SPFx API requests
Microsoft 365 resource policy or eligible Power Platform billing plan
Must cover the exact agent or environment; verify active coverage
Status from handover: build and 5 unit tests passed; live chat, billing coverage, harness support, and token refresh remain open.
5 November 2026 · Official Microsoft service artwork · SPFx, MSAL, SDK, npm and Heft are components or tools, not separate hosted services.
